description: Sri Lanka Parliament - Convening of the Parliament of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka on Saturday the 01st of the of July, 2023 at 9.30 a.m.
categorisation: This gazette content is a notification by the Speaker of Parliament convening a session of Parliament. This falls under electoral and parliamentary processes, specifically the scheduling and convening of parliamentary sessions, which aligns with Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) covering "Election announcements and schedules" and related parliamentary matters.
